This document describes the maintenance 
 procedure P2 which should be performed on the auto transformer every five years 
 Y5 as indicated by in the title block.

The first draft is initiated by 
 eng. Sherif Mahrous Omar tested by eng. Nafad Kamel Mahmoud, revised by UEEPCO. 
 quality control general director eng. Gamal Abd Elwahab, accepted by technical 
 expert eng. Hassan Elbehiry and approved by eng. Mohamed Gamal Diab Head 
 sector of El-Kureimat power station.

Check measurement of resistance (record the value).

Check for stuck carbon (clean and wash in fresh oil).
Check for loosen terminal (tighten up and clamp).
Check Loose Geneva pinion roller etc. due to abnormal wear
Check any deformation or abnormal wear in Geneva gear groove etc.

If it is faulty and has to be replaced or adjusted, the work can not be done 
 within the transformer and along repair program will be needed.

Check abnormal wear or arc trace, examine the operational sequence with 
 diverter switch if there is arc trace, and check the operational condition in 
 closing and opening if extreme wear is found.
Check broken contact spring (replace if necessary).

Check spark trace or crack in any insulation, investigate the cause and 
 replace (for replacement of moving contact insulation cylinder, the tab 
 selector has to be lifted out).

Check loose terminal or any breakage on lead taping, give an additional 
 tapping if necessary and check the coarseness on the surface and repair and 
 tighten up.
Check deformation or crack in change-over switch shunt (replace if necessary).

Check any fallen matters on the bottom of the transformer tank under the tap 
 selector, if there is any fallen matter; find out its original position to 
 return it there.

items:
Remove the protective covers to check for rusting and wear or dislocation of 
 pins and washers.

Opening the cover of the bevel gear mechanism and check the bevel gears for 
 abnormality. Apply grease over the teeth.
Measurement is to be made only when the motor drive is electrically abnormal.

Measure the insulation resistance between the live part and the ground after 
 disconnecting the incoming cables from the external terminals. The resistance 
 should be above 1 M ohm (by 500 V Megger at 20 C).

Measure the minimum operating voltage when the motor drive is electrically 
 abnormal.

Check to see that the motor and breaking contactors and step relay operate at 
 a voltage below 85 percent of the rated voltage.

sections.text: Tap changing equipment in total (final overall test after inspection)

Examine the followings after finishing the total assembly of the tap changing 
equipment:

items:
Check the agreement of the tap position between the motor drive and tap 
 changer.

Check the coordination of the operating sequence between the motor drive and 
 tap changer. In either direction the diverter switch should make its Owen 
 operation before the motor contactor is not deenergized.
Check the hand crank torque for the abnormality.
Check the starting and stopping.

Check the function of the electrical limit switches and overrun prevention 
 device in electrical and manual operation.

sections.text: Make remote operation from the control panel and check the following:
Confirmation of the step by step operation.

items: Confirmation of the step by step operation.
Confirmation of the electrical limit switches.

Confirmation of the alarm circuits (stagnation between taps and tripping of 
 the no-fuse breakers).

Confirmation of the agreement of the tap position indication between at the 
 control panel and at the motor drive.

Introduction

The first draft is initiated by
